description: A brown and white bulldog rides away from the camera on a small skateboard along the wet road of a campsite lined with parked caravans and pickup trucks. It pushes with one back leg past an American flag and a big mossy oak, gets smaller in the distance, then swings round and comes back the other way. In the last shot it rides straight towards the camera with its tongue out.
transcript: You go. All right, we're going right, Grayson, this way. All right, let's go get a treat.
